title: The inverse image of an embedding into finite pushforwards of constant sheaves is again such an embedding
statement:
Let $
u:X	o X'$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $F'$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X'_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $n\ge0$ and, for $i=1,\dots,n$, let $f_i:Y_i	o X'$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and $M_i$ a $\Lambda$-module, and let $\varphi:F'\hookrightarrow igoplus_{i=1}^nf_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$ be a monomorphism into the finite direct sum (biproduct [def-weil-additive-category]) in $\Mod(X'_{\Et},\Lambda)$, $\underline{M_i}$ the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M_i$ on $Y_{i,\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and $f_{i,*}$ the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then there are, for $i=1,\dots,n$, a finite morphism $g_i:Y'_i	o X$ locally of finite presentation (one may take the base change $Y'_i=Y_i	imes_{X'}X$, $g_i$ the second projection) and a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $
u^{-1}F'\hookrightarrow igoplus_{i=1}^ng_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$ in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$, with the same $M_i$, where $
u^{-1}$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].
